- Den Hoorn -  €15,29 per uur - Logistiek - 36 uur Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) Orderpicker at the large logistics company Van der Helm? The job is done with a tall Combi Truck. The worker sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is big enough, so the worker has space to sit and move safely. The machine can go very high, up to 12-16 meters. The worker goes up together with the cabin. Before going up, the worker puts an empty pallet on the forks. Sometimes there is a full pallet on the forks if it needs to be placed in the rack. When you are is high in the air, you takes boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The worker puts the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the work, the machine goes down. The worker drives the truck to another place in the warehouse. jobs.description: Rich gastronomy of all sorts plus a dash of Swiss charm—that is what you will love as our chef de parti at Mövenpick in Amsterdam. Bring your ideas to the table on the dishes we serve and ensure excellent preparation and the tastiest courses in a hygienic working environment. In doing so, you will make sure that our guests have a true experience. At Mövenpick, we make moments. Do you?Be limitlessRunning and standing are part of this profession and can happen at all times throughout the day. Whether it is lunch, dinner, or a banqueting event, you will ensure the right preparation, so when it gets busy, you and your team can get to work quickly and efficiently. In this way the best dishes on the menu are created. Do you have your own ideas for dishes? Great! Contribute them and think along on how we can improve our menu and continuously innovate. We are one team with one task, so if you notice that the inventory is dwindling or if you need other products, then ring the bell. Are other departments involved in the dinner or event? Then you will also ensure open and accessible lines of communication with them. There are no limits to your abilities. In addition, you will be:• versatile. Lunch, dinner, snacks, or banqueting—no matter where we put you, you will ensure the best quality;• responsible for hygiene. You will keep your own bench clean and help others if necessary;• proficient in English. Because of our international roots, our working language is English.Afternoons, evenings and weekends— all these shifts will come along.Proud to presentMövenpick: the place to enjoy life. Inside, we create a space for our guests to enjoy by relaxing at the bar with a delicious cocktail or a creamy cappuccino. In our restaurants, you can discover the most delicious special dishes. We are originally from Switzerland, and we carry this luxurious gastronomic hospitality with us. ‘Enjoying life to the fullest.' That is our mantra for our guests, but also for you
